question.text: Let $[\cdot]$ be the greatest integer function. If $\alpha=\int_{0}^{64}\left(x^{1 / 3}-\left[x^{1 / 3}\right]\right) \mathrm{d} x$, then $\frac{1}{\pi} \int_{0}^{\alpha \pi}\left(\frac{\sin ^{2} \theta}{\sin ^{6} \theta+\cos ^{6} \theta}\right) \mathrm{d} \theta$ is equal to $\_\_\_\_$ .
